games.name: [EASTER🐰] Obby King Remastered
games.desc:
Obby King is a fast-paced obstacle course game built for players who enjoy competitive challenges and exciting gameplay. Race through 100+ unique obbies, beat the clock, and compete against other players in a single continuous tournament experience.

There are rounds. Whether you’re new to Obby King or an experienced obby player, the game is easy to pick up and challenging to master.

Stay focused. Move fast. Claim the crown.

Features
- Round-style gameplay - compete from start to finish
- Time-based challenges - speed and accuracy matter
- Progress-based competition - keep up to stay in the action
- 100+ obby maps with increasing difficulty
- Earn coins and customise your character
- Leaderboards - track progress and show your skills

Invite your friends, enter the tournament, and see who rises to the top.

games.name: The Legend of The Bone Sword RPG
games.desc:
Embark on a perilous journey to reclaim your homeland from the Bone Lord's evil grasp. Progress through unique worlds and challenges as you grow stronger and collect strange weapons.

But things are not as they seem. Chaos lingers above, waiting to possess you at your darkest hour. How could you let this happen?

This game is a work in progress, please report any issues.
The old version is still available to play, just follow the floating platforms in The Old Sanctuary.
The classic version - https://www.roblox.com/games/6536023653/

games.name: Welcome to Roblox Building
games.desc:
A rewrite of "Welcome to Roblox Building", which was a sandbox building place hosted by Roblox around 2010-2016. 

This remaster of the game features more blocks, more baseplate customization, modernized interfaces, less exploits, save slots, and almost no limit to how much you can build!

This game is still a work in progress! Not all features have been fully polished and implemented yet. If you have any feedback, feel free to send a message to CloneTrooper1019! Thanks!

Special thanks to the team behind the original WTRB:

games.desc:
🌿💼 𝐖𝐄𝐋𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐄 𝐓𝐎 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐆𝐑𝐄𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍 𝐅𝐄𝐃𝐄𝐑𝐀𝐋 𝐁𝐎𝐑𝐃𝐄𝐑!
Your objective is to cross the heavily guarded border checkpoint - alive. Immigrate using your personal documents or attempt to sneak past the Border Guards. Or, rebel against the regime and fight back with EZIC to reclaim territory.
Ready to cross the line? Play now & shape your life.

Papers, Please is a roleplay game where players attempt to immigrate into the fictional city of Grestin. Cross the imperialist fortress and work a job to get paid, or live a life of crime - sneak past border guards & steal from stores to make a living; it's up to you. Inspired by Lucas Pope's "Papers Please".
